cabin: Inside an airliner cabin before take-off, view from a window seat, a nervous man's hands gripping the armrest in the next seat, the wing visible through the small window, no faces visible.
jetbridge: Looking down at a running man's shoes on the carpet of an airport jet bridge, one shoelace untied and dragging, the corridor stretching ahead.
window: Silhouettes of people seen from behind at a huge airport terminal window, far away at the end of the runway a bright fireball and black smoke.
escalator: A crowded airport escalator going down seen from above, metal steps with sharp comb teeth at the bottom, a hand holding a phone, people's backs.
police: A small windowless airport police room, a metal table with a phone and a notebook, an officer's hands writing, harsh overhead light, no faces.
cafe: An airport cafe table with a cup of coffee and a plate of eggs and bread, a TV on the wall in the background showing smoke, morning light.
recruiter: A hand holding a mobile phone in an airport corridor, the screen glowing with no readable text, a laptop bag on the shoulder, blurred travellers.
airline: An airline service desk at an airport, a worker's hands giving a paper voucher across the counter, a long queue of travellers seen from behind.
ride: View from the back seat of an old car without a taxi sign, the driver's eyes in the rear-view mirror, rain on the windscreen, a fire truck with lights coming on a narrow road ahead.
reception: An old airport hotel reception desk, two room keys with plastic tags on the counter, a bell, a tired receptionist's hands, a lobby with worn carpet.
charger: Close-up of a cheap no-name phone charger with a thin cable on a hotel reception counter, a five euro note next to it.
sister: A mobile phone on a hotel bed lighting up with an incoming call, the screen showing no readable text, crumpled sheets, afternoon light through curtains.
rest: A dim hotel room, an unmade bed, a man lying with his arm over his eyes, heavy curtains, a thin line of light.
window-high: A high hotel window opened wide, curtains blowing inward, a plane taking off over the runway in the distance, the room door half open.
spa: An empty hotel garden after rain, wet paths and benches, a small basement window near the ground with smoke drifting out.
news: An old hotel television in a dark room showing a news broadcast of a burning plane on a runway, no readable text, the edge of a bed.
dinner: A room service tray on a hotel bed, a plate under a metal cover, a glass of water, the TV glow on the wall.
smell: A long empty hotel corridor at evening, dim lights, a service door slightly open at the end, a faint haze in the air.
bar: A quiet hotel bar at night, a glass of whisky on the counter, the barman's hands wiping a glass, bottles in soft light, no faces.
rooftop: A hotel rooftop pool at night, a man seen from behind sitting on a glass railing over the drop, city and runway lights below.
roof-alone: An empty hotel rooftop at night, a loose glass railing panel, a sun lounger, a plane's lights crossing the dark sky above.
interview: A laptop seen from behind on a hotel desk at night, only the glow of the screen lighting a man's hands on the keyboard, a desk lamp and a cup, the screen itself not visible.
hotplug: Close-up of a cheap phone charger plugged into a hotel wall socket at night, a thin wisp of smoke, a laptop cable running from it.
novak: A hotel room door seen from inside at night, light under the door and the shadow of two feet, a hand on the door handle.
bath: A hotel bathtub filled with steaming water, a phone charging on the edge of the tub with its cable stretched to a socket.
sleep: A hotel bed at night seen from the doorway, soft pillows, a dark window with distant runway lights.
alarm: Smoke curling under a hotel room door at night, a red fire alarm light flashing on the ceiling, wet towels on the floor.
stairs-fire: A hotel fire staircase full of smoke, a woman in a hotel uniform sitting on the steps holding her ankle, seen from behind, an emergency light.
exit-door: A hotel lobby full of smoke, glass entrance doors jammed shut, a kitchen door open to the side with a dark corridor behind.
count: A crowd of hotel guests seen from behind wrapped in blankets in the rain at night, firefighters and a fire truck with lights in front of a smoking hotel.
boarding: A torn wet paper boarding pass lying face down on a dark wet street in the rain at night, red fire truck lights reflected in the puddles.
